data.sections.canBuild.name: Name
data.sections.canBuild.name.description: List of unit identifiers this unit can create. Can be buildings or units. Add "setRally" to create a rally button
data.sections.canBuild.pos.description: Order build link appears in this unit UI.
data.sections.canBuild.tech.description: Tech level. Mostly just affects build link colour in this unit UI. Defaults to 1.
data.sections.canBuild.forceNano.descrip: Builds target as if it was a building if true. (even if it's a unit)
data.sections.canBuild.isVisible.descrip: Hide this build link if true in this unit UI.
data.sections.canBuild.isLocked.descript: Dynamically locks this build option and shows isLockedMessage if true.
data.sections.canBuild.isLockedMessage.d: Set to tell to players why a unit is locked.
data.sections.canBuild.isLockedMessage_e: LANG = ISO 639-1 Code to show this text instead when game is in this language.
data.sections.canBuild.isLockedAlt.descr: Another reason for this to be locked. Just allows a different message to be shown.
data.sections.canBuild.isLockedAlt2.desc: Like isLockedAlt but to show one more message.
data.sections.canBuild.addResources.desc: Adds these resources to self when placing the building or producing the unit.
data.sections.canBuild.price.description: Overrides builded units/buildings price. Defaults to target unit prices.
data.sections.canBuild.isGuiBlinking.des: Generates a blinking effect in UI if true.
